subject: Re: BridgePay Order Form — commercial redlines and invoice/tax path
messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@bridgepay.com>

Cc: contracts@bridgepay.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: BridgePay Order Form — commercial redlines

Hi Chloe / Kimberly,

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached is our redline to the Order Form (BridgePay_OrderForm_Redline_v1.pdf) — high level notes: 
- Minimum commit: we pushed to a 12-month staircase (Q1 25%, Q2 25%, Q3 25%, Q4 25%) and removed the escalation credit language; please confirm if Redwood can accommodate.
- Net terms: legal has requested Net45 instead of Net30 due to internal billing cycles; would Redwood accept Net45 for the first 12 months?
- Taxes: BridgePay will provide a tax certificate (attached) but we need confirmation that Redwood will not gross-up EU VAT or treat BridgePay as agent for withholding.
- Invoicing cadence: we proposed monthly invoices with PO number on invoice — please confirm required invoice fields and the acceptance window.

We'd like to circulate a final version to procurement by end of this week. If there are any clauses you need to escalate, point us to the right contact and timeline.

Attachments: BridgePay_OrderForm_Redline_v1.pdf, tax_certificate_bridgepay.pdf

Best,
Sophie Grant
Head of Procurement, BridgePay
sophie@bridgepay.com

Sophie — thanks for the redline and the tax cert. Appreciate the clear asks. Quick update on timeline and next steps: 
1) I’ll loop legal for wording on Net45 / Net30 and invoice acceptance — Kimberly is on copy.
2) I’ll confirm whether the minimum-commit staircase you proposed is operationally compatible with our billing/activation triggers; that may impact how we define the activation fee/prorate language.
3) If legal signs off on the Net45 for year one, finance will need the PO fields you expect (PO number, billing entity, remit-to entity). Can you confirm the exact remit entity (BridgePay US vs BridgePay Global)?

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: BridgePay Order Form — commercial redlines (legal input)

Chloe / Karthik — legal reviewed the BridgePay redline and here are discrete suggestions we can offer back to procurement quickly. See attached redline_comments_legal.docx for line edits. High level: 

1) Net terms: We can accept Net45 for the first 12 months if BridgePay agrees to standard late-payment interest (1.5%/mo) and a mutual audit clause for billing disputes (30 day cure period). Proposed clause: 
"Payment terms: Client shall pay invoices within forty-five (45) days of receipt. Overdue amounts shall accrue interest at 1.5% per month. Parties agree to a 30-day dispute resolution and documentation exchange for billing discrepancies."

2) Minimum commit / staircase: Operationally acceptable, but we need specific activation and service start definitions tied to invoice triggers. Suggest we define: "Activation date = first day of service as evidenced by invoice for first billing cycle." Also keep a clause for true-up at each quarter boundary.

3) Taxes: Accept tax certificate for withholding relief if BridgePay executes a tax representation schedule and provides evidence of VAT registration where applicable. We will not unilaterally gross-up EU VAT without written notice; however, tax residency/withholding is client responsibility per section X.X. Recommend adding a short exception for documented VAT refunds.

4) Invoicing fields: Redwood requires PO number, billing entity, remit-to entity and contact. For Net45 to be granted, finance needs the remit-to entity legal name and EFT instructions prior to the first invoice. 

If Chloe/Karthik want, I can draft a short email reply to Sophie that includes the Net45 conditional language and a suggested activation/true-up sentence to avoid back-and-forth.

—Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachment: redline_comments_legal.docx
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@bridgepay.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BridgePay Order Form — commercial redlines

Chloe / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the suggested language. BridgePay can: 
- Accept conditional Net45 for the first 12 months (we agree to the 1.5%/mo interest but would like the late fee waived for the initial 60 days as a courtesy for onboarding).
- Confirm remit entity: BridgePay US, EIN 12-3456789; EFT instructions to follow via secure portal.
- Activation date language is OK; procurement will add the PO and we’ll accept the true-up approach at quarter boundaries.

I’ve attached an updated procurement note (contracts@bridgepay.com) and will push to our finance team to provide EFT details today. If you can send the short email you mentioned with the conditional Net45 language + activation/true-up sentence, we’ll attach that to our procurement file and aim to sign this week.
